environment.description: Same container deployed in hardened namespace 'processing-restricted'. Pod annotation specifies a custom OCI runtime seccomp profile loaded via RuntimeDefault override at containerd level (not a Kubernetes-native Localhost profile). The containerd config at /etc/containerd/config.toml sets the default_runtime_seccomp_profile to a custom JSON profile that maintains the standard Docker default allowlist but additionally moves execve, execveat, ptrace, socket, connect, bind, and listen to the deny list (SCMP_ACT_ERRNO with errno EPERM). This is applied at the shim level before container start. Note: the Go runtime itself uses clone and futex for goroutines which remain allowed. The profile was validated with 'ctr seccomp verify' against the container entrypoint.
